frontmatter.name: grill-with-docs
frontmatter.description: A relentless interview to sharpen a plan or design, which also creates docs (ADR's and glossary) as we go. Use before starting any new feature, idea, or plan on this repo.

frontmatter.name: implement
frontmatter.description: Implement a piece of work based on a spec or set of tickets. Use whenever asked to implement, build, or work on a ticket/issue in this repo — runs TDD at the agreed seams, then /code-review, then commits.
